def equation(gate_voltage_abs: np.ndarray, drain_voltage_abs: np.ndarray, parameters: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Modelo empírico bivariado para log10(|ID|/A)."""
    k, Vt, mu, log_A = parameters[:4]
    log_k, log_Vt, log_mu, log_prefactor = parameters[4:]
    return log_prefactor + log_A - log_k * (gate_voltage_abs - Vt) + log_mu * drain_voltage_abs
